{"result": "{
  "number": 3129,
  "title": "fix: use RequestInit['headers'] in normalizeHeaders",
  "state": "open",
  "draft": false,
  "author": "theOguz16",
  "head": "fix/v1-normalize-headers-type",
  "base": "v1.x",
  "created_at": "2026-10-29T19:12:06Z",
  "updated_at": "2026-11-02T18:50:01Z",
  "merged_at": null,
  "url": "https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk/pull/3129",
  "body": "## Problem\n\n`normalizeHeaders` is exported with a bare `HeadersInit` parameter. `HeadersInit` is declared by the DOM lib only, so consumers that compile the SDK without DOM fail:\n\n```\n\"lib\": [\"ES2023\"], \"types\": [\"node\"], \"skipLibCheck\": false\n→ dist/cjs/shared/transport.d.ts(7,51): error TS2304: Cannot find name 'HeadersInit'.\n```\n\n`RequestInit` is declared globally by `@types/node` (via `undici-types`) as well as by DOM, so indexing into it resolves in both environments.\n\n## Change\n\n```diff\n-export function normalizeHeaders(headers: HeadersInit | undefined): Record<string, string> {\n+export function normalizeHeaders(headers: RequestInit['headers'] | undefined): Record<string, string> {\n```\n\nThis matches the signature already on `main` (`packages/core-internal/src/shared/transport.ts`), so it is a v1 backport of the same shape rather than a new API decision.\n\nThe `HeadersInit` references left in `src/client/sse.ts` and `src/client/streamableHttp.ts` are local variables and never reach the emitted declarations, so they are intentionally untouched to keep the diff minimal.\n\n## Verification\n\nPacked the branch and type-checked a consumer with `\"lib\": [\"ES2023\"]`, `\"types\": [\"node\"]`, `skipLibCheck: false`:\n\n- `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.30.0` → `TS2304` (see issue)\n- this branch → clean compile, and the emitted declaration reads `headers: RequestInit['headers']`\n\nAlso ran `npm run typecheck`, `eslint src/shared/transport.ts`, `prettier --check`, and `vitest run test/shared/transport.test.ts` (50/50).\n\nA `patch` changeset is included.\n\nFixes #2568\n",
  "mergeable_state": "clean",

  }
